$note: 財帛宮（2026-10-12）：財帛通則。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 財帛宮 p.436–462。倒閉、破產、官非、盜賊、火災、疾病一類斷語不用；金額、「巨富」一類保證不用；天刑、天月、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用。

rules.text: 財帛宮見祿存與天馬相會，成「祿馬交馳」，是求財最喜歡的配搭。
rules.en: Lu Cun and Tian Ma meeting in the Wealth Palace form the galloping-fortune pattern, the most welcome combination for earning.

rules.text: 文昌或文曲化忌，帶文書失誤的性質：簽約、支票一類事要格外小心。
rules.en: Wen Chang or Wen Qu in Obstruction carries a risk of paperwork errors: take extra care with contracts and cheques.

source.quote: 此二星化忌皆有文书失误的性质

rules.text: 地空或地劫在財帛宮，財帛容易突然有挫折性的變化。
rules.en: With Di Kong or Di Jie in the Wealth Palace, money is prone to sudden setbacks.

source.quote: 主突然产生挫折性的变化

rules.text: 擎羊在財帛宮，求財多要面對競爭，你常要與人相爭。
rules.en: With Qing Yang in your Wealth Palace, earning usually means facing competition, and you often have to contend with others.

source.quote: 擎羊坐财帛宫，基本主竞争

rules.text: 陀羅在財帛宮，你的錢常常來得慢，要有耐性。
rules.en: With Tuo Luo in your Wealth Palace, money often arrives late, so patience helps.

rules.text: 火星或鈴星在財帛宮，你進財較困難，要勞心勞力。
rules.en: With Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the Wealth Palace, money is harder to come by and takes effort of mind and body.

rules.text: 見左輔右弼，可以憑別人的助力生財，也可以考慮自己經營。
rules.en: With Zuo Fu or You Bi, others help you earn, and running your own business is worth considering.

source.quote: 则可凭别人助力以生财

rules.text: 見天魁天鉞，有生財的機會，往往隨制度改變而來。
rules.en: With Tian Kui or Tian Yue, chances to earn come your way, often when rules or systems change.

rules.text: 見文昌文曲，主要是增加聲譽；也可能憑文藝或學術生財。
rules.en: With Wen Chang or Wen Qu, the main gain is reputation; money may also come through writing, the arts or scholarship.
